rules: A cycle is a run of the workflow named in workflow, triggered by schedule; GitHub runs scheduled workflows on the default branch only.
A cycle qualifies when the run concluded success on its first attempt and was never re-run, so every job without continue-on-error succeeded.
Manually dispatched runs, runs of other workflows, and local runs are never cycles.

The streak counts qualifying cycles on consecutive UTC dates, newest first, starting on the current or the previous UTC date. A scheduled run that did not conclude success ends it, and so does a UTC date without a completed scheduled run. Any re-run ends the streak, even of a run whose first attempt succeeded, because the API reports only the latest attempt; do not re-run scheduled nightly runs. A run that has not completed is never counted: a run in progress dated today leaves the streak to the completed runs before it, and one dated earlier leaves its date without a completed run.

Changes to this repository's sources, reference pins included, do not restart the count; per-push CI gates them. Until 2026-10-09 the ledger counted only runs at the pinned ref/capnp-zig revision; the Zig generator then moved to capnp-zig and the reference was removed.

scripts/audit-nightly.ts (mise run audit:nightly) computes every other field from the GitHub API; only requiredConsecutiveScheduledRuns, rules, publicationAuthorized, and supersedes are edited by hand.
